articles.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
articles.snippet: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indexes could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.

articles.title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
articles.snippet: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.

articles.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
articles.snippet: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.

articles.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
articles.snippet: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
